about: How this repo relates to the HyperBench hub its conventions came from. Existing-fleet adoption (hub docs/ADOPT_EXISTING_REPO.md): what was copied is host-owned; later hub changes arrive only by an intentional reconciliation PR here. hyperbenchVersion is source provenance only. Scope set by the operator (memory/mem-001): the same scope as ragesaq/AllegianceVR, from which the HyperBench files were copied at its reviewed enrollment head 90ba914: memory, work map, knowledge, recall with vectors, the lifecycle skill and the data-boundary tripwire, with the two-agent collaboration rules in AGENTS.md. AGENTS.md is the upstream author's file with the fork's section appended at the end. line-endings is skipped because its checker requires every tracked file to be LF, and this fork keeps upstream AllegianceCore files byte-identical (33 are committed with CRLF and one with mixed endings) so upstream merges stay clean. .gitattributes is new here and gives each HyperBench-owned file its own eol=lf rule, naming files rather than folders because docs/ and tools/ also hold upstream files. tools/check_map.py and tools/check_node_loss.py are changed only to compare against origin/master, this fork's default branch. tools/check_data_boundary.py writes its fine-grained GitHub token pattern as github_pa[t]_, which matches the same strings, because the upstream publish guard rejects any added line that spells the prefix out. Starter files (AGENTS.md's appended section, DAG.json, LEDGER.md, memory/README.md, memory/CANARY.md, knowledge/README.md, knowledge/TEMPLATE.md, GROUND_RULES.md) descend from the hub's templates/repo-starter/ at starterVersion, not from the hub's own root copies; the memory store is memory/v1 because the catalog is skipped.
